aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Kubera, lord of the yakṣas, O Lord;
Master, victory, victory to you, Kubera, lord of the yakṣas, O Lord.
Kubera fills the storehouses of the devotees who have come to his refuge.
aarti.pad1: Among the devotees of Śiva, Kubera is a great devotee;
Master, Kubera is a great devotee.
He fought a great many battles with daityas, dānavas and men.
aarti.pad2: He is seated on a golden throne,
and a canopy turns above his head;
Master, a canopy turns above his head.
The yoginīs sing songs of blessing,
and all raise the cry of victory.
aarti.pad3: In his hands are a mace and a trident;
He who frees from sorrow, fear and trouble
aarti.pad4: Dishes of every kind are prepared in plenty;
Master, dishes are prepared in plenty.
The devotees offer the sweet mohanbhog,
and with it black gram and chickpeas.
aarti.pad5: You are the giver of strength, wisdom and knowledge;
we have fallen at your refuge;
Master, we have fallen at your refuge.
You set right all the works of your devotees.
aarti.pad6: A jewel shines in your crown,
and a necklace of pearls is at your throat;
Master, a necklace of pearls is at your throat.
There is a wick of agarwood and camphor,
and a flame of ghee burns.
aarti.pad7: Whoever sings the āratī of Kubera, lord of the yakṣas —
gains the fruit his heart desires.
